# A conflict gets a merge task at most twice. If the file unresolvable exists, the fake agent leaves the branch as it is, so the pull request conflicts again and the swarm holds it for a person.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec beehaveswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec beehaveswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# Two merge tasks ran, not three.
grep -count=2 '^resolve ' calls.log

# Only the P0 task landed. The P2 task did not.
grep -count=1 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log
exec git --git-dir=remote.git show main:a.txt
stdout 'swarm-3'

# The report names the task that needs a person.
exec grep -rhao '1 landed, 1 need a person' state

-- unresolvable --
-- backlog.txt --
P2	late	a.txt
P0	first	a.txt
